Folks -

I'm currently moderating a PBF game of Sentinels at Boardgamegeek featuring the Freedom Five taking on the Vengeful Five. One of our players got a bit excited at seeing Vengeance stuff and forgot he's leaving tomorrow on a cruise. If'n you've got an account over there, we could use somebody to play Tachyon (who is the last hero in the turn order).

The BGG convention has a moderator tracking decks & HP rather than the custom here of people using physical decks, so if you're using Tachyon in something here you shouldn't need to rearrange your deck.
